source.boundary: Current ARM64 owns gauge transitions and NGUIText consumption; level3 owns the 64-object/45-widget graph; current clips and GLES3 own high-rank sampling/SoftClip. CS-V1 remains PRODUCT_ONLY input.

nativeThresholdInput.validation: music/difficulty identity exact; unsigned integer thresholds strictly C<B<A<S<SS; no defaults or BMS/scoreLevel derivation

gauge.rankBoundaries: score<threshold; exact threshold enters the named rank
gauge.ratio: Float32(uint(score))/Float32(uint(scoreMax)); UISlider clamps, callback receives unclamped ratio
gauge.productBoundary: CS-V1 thresholds and scoreMaximum remain PRODUCT_ONLY input; only presentation formulas are shared.

encodedText.overflow: not truncated; maxDigit only controls prepended zero count

nativeConsumption.formula: dynamic Font.GetCharacterInfo(ch, finalSize, style); GlyphInfo.advance is CharacterInfo.advance multiplied by Float32 font scale/pixel density; printed width sums advance+finalSpacingX and removes trailing spacing

currentScoreDomain.shrink: decrement integer finalSize until encoded-symbol-stripped glyph advance sum <= 188

all_perfect_confusion_resolution.disposition: distinct sibling UIPanel objects; path_id 1450 belongs to AllPerfectAnimation, while path_id 1451 belongs to Score/Progress/Panel and clips HighRankEffect

geometry.owner_subtree: Score/Progress/Panel/HighRankEffect and its eleven visual descendants
geometry.right_anchor: target left side x=38 because relative=0, plus mutable absolute
geometry.left_anchor: target left side x=38 because relative=0, plus absolute 4
geometry.resolved_panel_y: Background_Cover vertical sides are -17.5 and 15.5; bottom=-17.5-8=-25.5; top=15.5-2=13.5; center=-6; height=39
geometry.pixi_local_visible_rect: x=[42,38+indicatorLocalX], y=[-13.5,25.5] after Unity Y-up to Pixi Y-down; NGUI enforces minimum size 2 if anchors cross
geometry.pixi_viewport_rect: Score owner at [389,51], Progress at [25,45]; viewport x=[456,452+indicatorLocalX], y=[82.5,121.5]
geometry.float_int_policy: consume binary32 ratio; binary32 multiply by 422; trunc toward zero; ratio>=1 selects 422

gles3.rgba: exact committed GLES3 source in softClipShader.gles3File

play.phase: start at Float32 zero, advance by Animator/game delta, wrap at three seconds; remaining in same rank does not restart
